dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Linear, symmetrical decrease in pixel width from the mid-thorax region to the terminal visible point of the peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized inward deviation of the right lateral pixel-boundary approximately two-thirds down the longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white baseline with uniform reflectance across the primary dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, isolated dark pixel cluster visible on the distal right margin of the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct geometric indentation on the right lateral margin posterior to the mid-section, interrupting the expected smooth curvilinear contour.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark oval aperture positioned on the dorsal midline in the anterior region, surrounded by a subtle raised blowhole prominence.
